name: semantic-crosscheck
description: Cross-layer verification for an ontology plus semantic layer on PostgreSQL 17, for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Prove that a PostgreSQL closure, SHACL rules, OWL reasoning and a Cube model agree.
interface.longDescription: Release v0.2.0: cross-checks PostgreSQL 17 closures, SQL and SHACL rules, OWL reasoning with HermiT and Cube answers against gold SQL. Adds bounded synthetic SQL counterexample search, row-deletion shrinking and replay, plus optional owner-maintained data-revision binding and engine fingerprints. Results retain counts and ids; only separate synthetic replay fixtures contain generated rows. Query errors and bounded agreement never prove equivalence, and revision probes do not provide a shared cross-session snapshot.
defaultPrompt: Use semantic-crosscheck to run the synthetic demo end to end.
Use semantic-crosscheck to verify my crosscheck.toml against PostgreSQL and explain what is not proven.
